points.description: Justifies that a spinlock does not always spin: if the lock is already available/free, it is acquired immediately without spinning (spinning happens only when the lock is held by another).
points.partial_credit: Half or so if the justification is vague, e.g. says spinning is only sometimes needed or only under contention, without clearly saying a free lock is taken at once.

rubric.notes: Full marks: says FALSE and explains that when the lock is free it is acquired without spinning. Part marks: FALSE with a vague or incomplete reason (e.g. spins only when contended). No marks for TRUE, or for FALSE with no reason or a wrong reason, since no correct justification means no marks.
